chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from some of our companions, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If you mention the name of Allah during wudu (ablution), your whole body becomes purified; and if you do not mention it, nothing of your body is purified except what the water passes over.

key_terms.إِذَا: when; introducing the condition stated in the hadith
key_terms.جَسَدُكَ: your body; the physical body of the person performing wudu (ablution)
key_terms.سَمَّيْتَ: you mentioned the name of Allah; that is, performing tasmiyah
key_terms.ٱلْمَاءُ: water; the means by which the external washing occurs
key_terms.ٱلْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution); the ritual washing before acts of worship

ai.seo_question: What is the effect of saying the name of Allah during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the importance of saying the name of Allah during wudu (ablution). It teaches that tasmiyah gives a more complete spiritual purification, while without it, purification is limited to the bodily parts reached by water.
